name: Infection Analyse Results - Part 4
content: We have found the last ingredient. Ground into the mixture, a lunar crawler spike cluster keeps the compound stable long enough to be injected, and the samples we prepared this way have held for days without losing their potency. The formula is now complete and can be produced in the laboratory. We are preparing for the next phase of testing, which will involve administering the vaccine to infected subjects to evaluate its efficacy and safety. We are optimistic that this vaccine will be a crucial tool in our fight against the infection and will help us save countless lives.
